answer: Give every identity a sable ledger of public work and force newcomers through a canyon of costly, verifiable tasks before they can trade: each agent must complete jobs whose outputs peers can re-check, so a Sybil operator pays the full cost once per fake face instead of once per army. After sustained honest work, the network stamps the identity with a non-transferable onyx seal that unlocks higher-value trade, while sealed identities that cheat lose the seal and all accumulated standing. Cloning then costs more than it earns, because trust is earned slowly in public and destroyed instantly.
